mission: 黎明書局的責任不是以中文原生館藏為中心，而是幫助中文閱讀者更好地閱讀世界上的可用作品。大量外文資源因此是核心基礎，不是附屬館藏。

collectionModel.principle: collection admission and Chinese reading capability grow together

tracks.goal: 持續把既有大型外文 acquisition pools 正規化、去重、判權、提升為 canonical Works。
繼續擴充原生中文非聖經作品。
外文 canonical Work 一旦具備合法可讀 source，即可進入原文/繁中/對照閱讀能力，不必等待正式中文出版物。

foreignPrioritySources: existing IIIF and historical Christian text sources
admissionPipeline: exclude Bible Scripture text from translation product
promote eligible Work to canonical collection
expose translation eligibility to Dawn Library reader
scaleRule: Large source counts are not displayed as collection counts. Only admitted canonical Work identities count as holdings; source records, editions, volumes and mirrors remain subordinate relations.
readerConsequence: The browse leaf must become language-agnostic at the Work layer. Language is a facet and reading condition, not a wall separating foreign works from Chinese readers.
translationConsequence: For eligible foreign Works, Chinese is a reading projection generated from the authoritative source text. It does not create a fake Chinese edition or duplicate Work identity.
existingChineseEditionReference: Existing copyrighted Chinese editions may contribute lawful bibliographic and terminology signals but are never silently ingested or reconstructed as the generated reading layer.
bibleBoundary: Bible text and Bible translations in other languages remain excluded from this translation product. Non-Scripture books about theology, history, spirituality, church life, culture and related subjects remain eligible according to rights policy.
designConsequence: 黎明書局的 visual browse should eventually mix Chinese and foreign canonical Works naturally. A foreign-language cover is not a warning state; translation availability is a positive reading affordance. The interface should help a Chinese reader choose a work first, then decide original/繁中/對照.
operationalRule: Foreign canonical admission must continue in parallel with cover enrichment and interface planning. Do not pause collection growth while waiting for final layout design.
successDefinition: The value of Dawn Library is measured less by how many Chinese files it stores and more by how much trustworthy world-language material it can make legible and readable to Chinese readers through one canonical reading system.
